meta.name: internal-comms
meta.description: A set of resources to help me write all kinds of internal communications, using the formats that my company likes to use. Claude should use this skill whenever asked to write some sort of internal communications (status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, incident reports, project updates, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按公司模板撰写各类内部通知与报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要频繁撰写公司内部沟通文档。
copy.tagline_en: Write internal communications using company-approved formats.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently write internal company communications.

howto.what: 当你让它写内部沟通文本（如状态汇报、公司简报、常见问题回答等）时，它会先从技能自带的示例文件中调取对应类型的写作指南，并照其规定的格式、语气来起草；找不到对应类型时，它会先向你询问澄清。
howto.when: 当你要求它写内部沟通类文本（例如状态报告、领导更新、3P更新、公司简报等）时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这周进展、计划和问题整理成3P更新。
say.note: 会加载3P更新指南按公司格式写。

say.text: 写一份公司全员通讯，宣布下月搬迁安排。
say.note: 会匹配公司简报指南起草。

say.text: 这个变化要不要发员工FAQ？帮我写几个问答。
say.note: 会加载FAQ回答指南来组织问答。

howto.what_en: When asked to write internal communications, Claude loads a matching style guide from the skill's samples (e.g., 3P updates, newsletters, FAQs) and drafts the text following its format and tone. If no guide matches, it asks for clarification.
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever you ask Claude to write an internal communication, such as a status report, leadership update, 3P update, company newsletter, FAQ, or incident report.

say_en.text: Turn my progress, plans, and problems into a 3P update.
say_en.note: Loads the 3P guide and formats it.

say_en.text: Draft a company-wide newsletter about the office move.
Write an FAQ answering common questions about this change.
